name_reason: Current name carries a trailing _50086 that equals the symbol's own address (0x50086) -- pure Ghidra address residue, not a domain ID. The descriptor 'field_map_fdicon_not_found_err' is already unique among the strtab.c strings (only one FDICON.B24 not-found message exists), so the address suffix adds no disambiguation value and should be dropped. Prefix data_fd2_ (game global) + _string_ (datatype) are correct.
purpose: Read-only ASCII C string holding the FDICON.B24 file-not-found error message printed before exit when the portrait-sheet open fails during chapter battle-data load.
logic_summary: Sole reader is fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (xref DATA from 0x00010a51). On the fopen("FDICON.B24","rb") failure path the function sets the input-key global to 3, calls int386(0x10,...) to reset to text mode, loads the address of this string into err_msg, then printf(err_msg) and exit(). Mirrors the sibling OOM strings in the same function (0x50064 etc.). Never written by the game; consumed as a char* by printf.
element_semantics:
Each byte is one ASCII char of the message "

 File not found 'FDICON.B24!! 

" (note the original's single unbalanced quote before FDICON and trailing '!!'), terminated by a NUL byte (35 bytes total: 34 text + NUL).
notes: Memory at 0x50086 (35 bytes) byte-matches src definition and the decompiled fixup '-> 00000086'. Datatype in Ghidra = string, len 35. No data plate existed (was null) so one was created via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) summarizing the src conclusion. src comment (strtab.c lines 47-51) is already accurate and precise -> not edited. is_const=true: zero game-side write-xrefs, single reader loads it only as a printf char*.
